name: First Light
hint: Swipe along a wall to slide. Past the edge you keep flying until you hit the next wall.

name: Angles
hint: Violet ramps mirror your flight 90 degrees. You can't stick to their slanted side.

name: Kick
hint: Pink launch pads: TAP (or Space) to kick straight off them, away from the wall.

name: Event Horizon
hint: Black holes bend your flight - get too close and you're swallowed. You're safe while stuck to a wall.

name: Phantom Run
hint: Everything at once: ramps, a pad and a black hole. Follow the shards - and use the hole's pull.
